\par\smallskip
\parbox{\textwidth}{\tiny AUROC: how well a reader's reading of the answer-spot state, through the model's own final norm and unembedding, predicts the answer the model gives (yes/no, test/real, and for letter questions whether the picked letter is the correct one, which mixes the model's answer with the ground truth; for refusal rows, on MM-SafetyBench scenarios with the benchmark's typographic carrier and MOSSBench, the reply refusing or the prompt being harmful), averaged, for every reader, over the blocks V-Read is fitted at within normalised depth 0.45--0.8, a window set after the first depth curves were seen (Table~\ref{tab:vread_window} gives others). Small type: a 95\% bootstrap interval, pictures (the source photograph of an edit, else the record's group) resampled 1000 times, the same resample for every reader and block; refusal rows of Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct predate the stored per-record readings and carry no interval. Columns per model: $n$ scored records; V-Read, an affine map per block fitted without labels in closed form (least squares; the ridge penalty settles at the bottom of its grid in nearly every block) on unlabelled SimonSays prompts, the primary fit and the only one a cell is judged by; V-Read fitted on unlabelled COCO photographs, a separate reader shown for reference, never used to choose a winner or count a cell (no baseline has a COCO-fitted counterpart); the best label-free baseline, each at its paper protocol: TL tuned lens (Belrose et al.\ 2023, the published recipe in every cell: 250 Nesterov-SGD steps of 262,144 tokens, lr\_scale 1, weight decay 0.001; fitted on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, Qwen3.5-27B), JL Jacobian lens (Anthropic 2026; fitted on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, Qwen3.5-27B, gemma-4-26B-A4B-it, InternVL3_5-8B-HF), PS Patchscopes (Ghandeharioun et al.\ 2024, in whichever of its two target prompts reads the answer better on that model: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct plain-text, Qwen3.5-27B plain-text, gemma-4-26B-A4B-it chat-template, InternVL3_5-8B-HF chat-template, a choice that can only favour it), LL logit lens (gemma-4-26B-A4B-it is compared against the Jacobian lens, Patchscopes and the logit lens only; InternVL3_5-8B-HF is compared against the Jacobian lens, Patchscopes and the logit lens only); the best baseline of a row is the maximum over the baselines present, chosen on the test data itself, which favours the baselines; ``margin'', V-Read minus that best baseline, with its paired 95\% interval (pictures resampled, the best baseline retaken inside each resample); ``result'': win when the whole interval is above 0, behind when it is below 0, level otherwise, untested without an interval; the labelled probe (logistic per block, fitted on every family of the task pooled, five folds grouped by picture across the pool, penalty and a PCA width in 16, 64, 256 or all chosen inside each training fold, each family scored on its own held-out records), a supervised reference, not a competitor and not an upper bound (grey italics); and $d_{.75}$, the earliest depth from which AUROC stays at or above 0.75 to the output, for V-Read and the earliest baseline, every reader read on V-Read's blocks. Shaded: V-Read. Underlined: the better of V-Read and the best baseline in the model's block for the row (ties at two decimals both underlined) and the earlier $d_{.75}$; * marks a V-Read value that is the better; $d_{.75}$ and the underlines are point estimates; nothing is bold. ``never'': the reader ends below 0.75. --: not run. No correction is made for comparing many cells. Records any lens was fitted on (and photographs in the COCO fit) are dropped for every reader, and all readers in a cell share its records. Records: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 5,218, Qwen3.5-27B 5,235, gemma-4-26B-A4B-it 937, InternVL3_5-8B-HF 970. Password-locking families are excluded; $^\dagger$ fewer than 5 of one answer (or under 24 records): AUROC shown, not used for win/level/behind counts (Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct: Generated scenes, edited, eval awareness, test/real, Generated scenes, edited, text swapped, Generated scenes, as taken, eval awareness, test/real, nuScenes, edited, eval awareness, test/real, Open Images, edited, eval awareness, test/real, Interfaces, edited, eval awareness, test/real, Interfaces, as taken, eval awareness, test/real; Qwen3.5-27B: Generated scenes, edited, eval awareness, test/real, Generated scenes, as taken, eval awareness, test/real, nuScenes, edited, authority, yes/no, nuScenes, edited, eval awareness, test/real, Open Images, edited, eval awareness, test/real, Interfaces, edited, eval awareness, test/real, Interfaces, as taken, eval awareness, test/real; gemma-4-26B-A4B-it: Generated scenes, edited, eval awareness, test/real, Generated scenes, as taken, authority, yes/no, Generated scenes, as taken, eval awareness, test/real, nuScenes, edited, authority, yes/no, nuScenes, edited, eval awareness, test/real, Open Images, edited, eval awareness, test/real, Interfaces, edited, eval awareness, test/real; InternVL3_5-8B-HF: Generated scenes, edited, eval awareness, test/real, Generated scenes, edited, text swapped, Generated scenes, as taken, authority, yes/no, Generated scenes, as taken, eval awareness, test/real, nuScenes, edited, eval awareness, test/real, Open Images, edited, eval awareness, test/real, Interfaces, edited, eval awareness, test/real, Interfaces, as taken, eval awareness, test/real); n/a$^\dagger$: no record of one answer, so AUROC is undefined; \textit{running}: a run or fit that has not landed (gemma-4-26B-A4B-it the tuned lens; InternVL3_5-8B-HF the tuned lens; a missing probe or a missing model block likewise); \textit{not read}: the model's behaviour pass stored no answer-spot states for that family. Efficiency, for the row's best baseline on that model: ``fit, best/V-Read'', its wall-clock fit time over V-Read's (``none'': Patchscopes and the logit lens are not fitted; ``running'': the fit has not landed); ``read cost, best'', what it costs at read time beyond the model's own final norm and unembedding, which every reader uses: matmul, one matrix multiply per block read (V-Read's cost too); fwd pass/block, one extra forward pass of the model per block read, per record (Patchscopes); none, the logit lens. The last row of each model gives the fit times; no clock includes the model's forward passes over the fit corpus, which every fitted lens needs. Fit cost in full: Table~\ref{tab:vread_cost}. $^\ddagger$: underpowered, shown but to be read with care (rarer answer under 20 records, or most of the model's own answers near a coin-flip): COCO, four-way object, Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, 15 of the rarer answer in 500; COCO, four-way object, Qwen3.5-27B, 16 of the rarer answer in 500; Open Images, as taken, eval awareness, test/real, Qwen3.5-27B, 85\% of the model's own final margins under 0.5 nats; WMDP carrier, chemistry, 3 instructions, gemma-4-26B-A4B-it, 19 of the rarer answer in 69; Open Images, as taken, eval awareness, test/real, InternVL3_5-8B-HF, 17 of the rarer answer in 112.}
